Name: OhoDavi Anime SVE Portraits for 1.6
Author: bezajel
Description:
I'm updating OhoDavi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Stardewvalley Anime Mods[/url] SVE portraits to include missing outfits and portrait variants. This will include the regular outfits (winter, beach, portrait variants), some of which are currently not available anywhere else.

﻿This is a WIP, see below for where I'm up to. I'll add portraits as I complete them, and once they are all uploaded, I'll see about packaging them as a CP mod. Hit the 'Track' button to be informed of updates!

[b]Note:[/b] ﻿[color=#f1f1f1]These are [/color][u]not[/u][color=#f1f1f1] full seasonal versions. If you want versions for seasonal cute, see recommended mods at the bottom of the page.[/color]


[b][size=5]What's Included?
[/size][/b]

[u][size=3]Main File:
[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Asset folder with portraits in PNG format. This is a replacement file to replace assets in the Stardew Valley Expanded mod.
[/list][color=#f1f1f1]
[u][size=3]Done:
[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Sophia - beach, winter, makeup and older variants
[*]Olivia - beach, winter, hand fix on original art
[/list]

[u][size=3]To Do:
[/size][/u]
[list]
[*]Variants for other SVE portraits made by OhoDavi
[*]Variants for OhoDavi-style portraits made by other artists - conditional on permissions
[*]Packaging as a CP mod
[/list][/color]

[size=5]﻿[b]Compatibility and Requirements
[/b][/size][size=2]

﻿As this is a replacement file for Stardew Valley Expanded, all compatibility and requirements are inherited from that mod.
[color=#f1f1f1]
Portraits were designed to match assets and file structure for[/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿[color=#f1f1f1] version [/color]﻿1.15.10.

[color=#f1f1f1]If using these portraits to replace files in other mods rather than in SVE directly, you may need to change file names to match the other mod.[/color]


[/size]How to Install?[size=2]
[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ by downloading, extracting, and placing in your Mods folder.
[*]Download and extract this mod's main file.
[*]Copy the "﻿[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded" folder from this mod, and paste it in the same place as the original SVE folder with the same name (this may be in a sub-folder in your Mods folder).
[*]﻿Select 'Replace All' (Windows) or 'Merge' (Mac)

[/list][size=5][b]Recommended Mods
[/b][/size]

Vanilla NPCs by OhoDavi:
[list]
[*]OhoDavi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Stardewvalley anime mods[/url]﻿
[*]my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31999]unofficial 1.6 update[/url]﻿
[/list]
OhoDavi Style:
[list]

[/list]

Alternatives for use with Seasonal Cute:

[*]Donut's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30482]SVE seasonal anime[/url]﻿
[*]Donut's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30172]Seasonal ES Portraits[/url]﻿
[/list]
